scripts.dev:web: cross-env ORBITOS_CLOUD_DEV=1 VITE_ORBITOS_RUNTIME=cloud npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.dev:legacy-web: cross-env ORBITOS_CLOUD_DEV=0 VITE_ORBITOS_RUNTIME=legacy npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.db:verify: supabase db reset --local && npm run db:lint && npm run db:test
scripts.db:rewind:verify: supabase --yes migration down --local --last 5 && supabase migration up --local && npm run db:test
